# Real vendor CI
This workflow is separate from the synthetic test. It requires a genuine Actions artifact containing vendor.new.dat.br, vendor.transfer.list, vendor-a16-sim2-lte-ril-ab-video6-UNTESTED.img and SHA256SUMS (exact three filenames, conventional two spaces). Input files are never committed to this repository. There is no direct ChatGPT attachment-to-Actions upload capability.
For a push-triggered run on alice-unified, set repository variables ALICE_VENDOR_INPUT_RUN_ID, ALICE_VENDOR_INPUT_REPOSITORY, ALICE_VENDOR_PUBLISH=true, then push a change to the workflow or reviewed plan. For a private source artifact in another repo, configure the read-only Actions token secret ALICE_VENDOR_INPUT_TOKEN. Manual workflow dispatch is available when this workflow exists on the default branch. The workflow stops on missing real inputs, and publishes the actual difference report only after output publication is authorized. This repository is public: **outputs and logs can be public**; use a private repository if firmware must remain private. No upload is performed without an explicit publication opt-in.
The base is the .dat.br and transfer list. The IMG is donor only. After inspecting the real audit, commit alice/vendor/reviewed-plan.json with reviewed paths and matching base/donor SHA256 values (see README.md). Review dependent HALs, libraries, VINTF, init and SELinux together. No plan is invented. Merge only reviewed regular files with identical ownership, mode and xattrs; additions and metadata changes require separate review. The CI emits the raw IMG and complete OTA dat.br/transfer list after filesystem and byte-identical reconstruction checks. No AVB regeneration or hardware test; outputs are explicitly UNTESTED. A successful audit does not imply working SIM2/LTE/LED/video.
